products.name: STANDARD™ Q Malaria P.f/Pan Ag Test
products.short_description: Rapid qualitative detection of P. falciparum-specific HRP-2 and Plasmodium species-specific pLDH antigens in whole blood.
products.description: A rapid immunochromatographic assay for the qualitative detection of Plasmodium falciparum-specific HRP-2 antigen and Plasmodium species-specific pLDH antigen, including P. falciparum, P. vivax, P. ovale and P. malariae, in capillary or venous whole blood. The test is intended for use by trained healthcare professionals, laboratory personnel or other appropriately trained health workers.

products.name: STANDARD™ Q HCV Ab Test
products.short_description: Rapid qualitative detection of antibodies to hepatitis C virus in human serum, plasma or whole blood.
products.description: A rapid chromatographic immunoassay for the qualitative detection of antibodies to hepatitis C virus in human serum, plasma or whole blood. It is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use as an aid to the early diagnosis of HCV infection.
specifications: Whole blood 20 µl; serum or plasma 10 µl

products.name: STANDARD™ Q HBsAg Test
products.short_description: Rapid qualitative detection of hepatitis B surface antigen in serum, plasma or whole blood.
products.description: A rapid chromatographic immunoassay for the qualitative detection of hepatitis B surface antigen. It is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use as an aid to early diagnosis of HBV infection and provides an initial screening result that should be confirmed with a more specific diagnostic method when appropriate.

products.name: STANDARD™ Q HIV 1/2 Ab 3-Line
products.short_description: Rapid qualitative detection and differentiation of HIV-1 and HIV-2 antibodies in serum, plasma or whole blood.
products.description: A rapid chromatographic immunoassay for the qualitative detection of antibodies specific to HIV-1, including subtype O, and HIV-2 in human serum, plasma, or venous and capillary whole blood. It is intended for in vitro diagnostic use as an aid to diagnosis in symptomatic and asymptomatic populations and people at risk of HIV infection.
specifications: Serum, plasma, venous whole blood and capillary whole blood
Capillary whole blood 100% (71/71); venous whole blood 99.01% (100/101); serum 99.84% (622/623); plasma 99.78% (456/457)

products.name: STANDARD™ Q Syphilis Ab Test
products.short_description: Rapid qualitative detection of antibodies to Treponema pallidum in whole blood, serum or plasma.
products.description: A rapid chromatographic immunoassay for the qualitative detection of antibodies to Treponema pallidum in human serum, plasma or whole blood. It is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use as an aid to the early diagnosis of syphilis infection.
specifications: Whole blood 20 µl; serum or plasma 10 µl
